results.title: Exicom Becomes the First Company in India to Manufacture Liquid-Cooled Power Modules for EV Chargers
results.description: HYDERABAD, India, Aug. 19, 2026 /PRNewswire/ — Exicom Tele-Systems Limited (BSE: 544133) (NSE: EXICOM), one of India’s leading EV charging and Critical Power companies, today announced the start of manufacturing for advanced liquid-cooled AC and DC power modules at its Hyderabad Smart Manufacturing Facility, making it the first company in India to produce this class [...]
